Chinese: 地震報告: 根據地球物理氣象局初步分析，本地時間2026年10月10日01時56分05秒，於巴拿馬發生7.6級地震，震源深度約為10公里，震中約位於北緯7.60度，西經80.80度，距離澳門約16352公里。
Portuguese: Comunicado de sismo: A DSMG informa que no dia 10-10-2026 pelas 01:56:05 (hora local) foi registado um sismo de magnitude 7.6, profundidade 10 km, e cujo epicentro se localizou a cerca de 16352 km a  de Macau, (7,60N, 80,80W), Panamá.
English: Earthquake Report: Initial analysis from Meteorological and Geophysical Bureau indicated that an earthquake of magnitude 7.6 , focal depth of 10 km, has occurred at 01:56:05 on 10 October 2026 (local time) in Panama. The epicentre is located near 7.60N, 80.80W, about 16352 kilometres  of Macao.
